name: Morlen
summary: Morlen is pure, unapologetic softness- a sofa that looks as though it was sculpted from a single, continuous breath of comfort. Its voluminous, rounded forms are the Morlen’s defining signature. Three plump, generously proportioned seat cushions flow seamlessly into an equally billowing backrest, while the low, gently curved arms tuck in with an almost playful tenderness. Every surface is enveloped in a beautifully textured woven fabric in a warm, natural tone – tactile, inviting, and utterly timeless. A single centred cushion nestles naturally into the back, adding a subtle focal point without disrupting the sofa’s wonderfully organic silhouette. Sitting low to the ground on a discreet base with a gleaming champagne gold finish, the Morlen feels as grounded as it does dreamy- a piece that anchors a room while making everyone in it feel instantly at ease. For interiors that celebrate warmth, texture, and the beauty of curves done with intention. 96x97x71 90.5x97x71
